desc: Exibe todas as sessões ativas e inativas do banco de dados

desc: Filtro Nativo Toad: WAIT FOR LOCK

name: LAST CALL > 10 MIN
desc: Filtro Nativo Toad: LAST CALL > 10 MIN

name: DUPLICATE USERNAMES
expr: EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM V$SESSION xxx WHERE s.USERNAME = xxx.USERNAME AND s.SID <> xxx.SID AND s.SERIAL# <> xxx.SERIAL# )

name: DUPLICATE PROGRAMS
expr: EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM V$SESSION xxx WHERE s.USERNAME = xxx.USERNAME AND s.PROGRAM = xxx.PROGRAM AND s.SID <> xxx.SID AND s.SERIAL# <> xxx.SERIAL# )

name: HIGH IO VS VALUES
desc: Filtro Nativo Toad: HIGH IO VS VALUES

name: HIGH IO VS AVERAGES
expr: io.PHYSICAL_READS >= ( SELECT AVG ( xxx.PHYSICAL_READS ) FROM v$sess_io xxx where xxx.PHYSICAL_READS > 0 ) OR io.BLOCK_CHANGES >= ( SELECT AVG ( yyy.BLOCK_CHANGES ) FROM v$sess_io yyy where yyy.BLOCK_CHANGES > 0 )
desc: Filtro Nativo Toad: HIGH IO VS AVERAGES
